description: The Slop Index: share of hackathon write-ups per year that GPTZero classed as AI-written or mixed with HIGH confidence, over the documents that have been scanned (gptzero.* fields are written back by the investigation). Takes no parameters. Returns year, scanned, ai, ai_share (percent). Only years with scanned documents appear; pre-2022 years act as the placebo false-positive baseline.

configuration.query: FROM {{INDEX}} | WHERE gptzero.confidence_category == "high" | STATS scanned = COUNT(*), ai = COUNT(*) WHERE gptzero.predicted_class != "human" BY year | EVAL ai_share = ROUND(100.0 * ai / scanned, 1) | SORT year
